params.economicTruth: Unrelated-payer settlement, successful fulfillment, replay/finality checks, liabilities and attributable costs remain required before Conway recognizes revenue or reinvestable profit.

x402scanFixedCoreRegistrationProof.truth: Fixed-core registration completeness is derived only from current external proof, owner approval, exact observed fixed-core count and registered state. It never implies dynamic-capability indexing or revenue.

commercialization.strictDemandRule: >=2 distinct unrelated external buyers OR >=1 unrelated external buyer with >=3 fulfilled events and >=3 cents gross

agentCommerceFederation.moneyMakingFlow: truthful discovery -> buyer/task demand evidence -> bounded hypothesis -> unrelated-payer qualification -> inherited R60 declarative compilation/canary -> x402 payable fulfillment -> settled attributable economics -> retained-profit evolutionary selection
agentCommerceFederation.evolutionBoundary: R119 may generate and score commercial hypotheses and observe public markets. It cannot manufacture demand, canary success, revenue, settlement, permissions or future certainty. Product birth remains inherited R60; economic truth remains fulfilled settled externally attributable economics.
